## Prevention remediation for incident 1c0d (code-review lane)

Post-mortem: `9097-2741-6462-424c`. Origin change `8fbd` ("Enable class-scoped Anthropic fallback") passed code review, yet it enabled a fallback whose terminal arm masks a retryable primary. This ticket implements the approved code-review criterion that would have flagged the disposition-masking class.

## Decision

Operator approved the narrow code-review lane already recorded in comments: add an advisory specialist overlay with the single canonical id `failover`, using Framing #3 plus the concrete Framing #1 disposition-preservation litmus. This is advisory (`blocking_enabled: false`), not blocking, to reduce false positives while giving reviewers an early warning.

## Scope

Add a code-review overlay sibling to existing advisory overlays such as `concurrency` / `performance`:

- add `failover` to `src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py` `OVERLAY_IDS`, so the closed overlay enum accepts it;
- register `failover` in `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json` with `blocking_enabled: false` and targeted fallback/retry/error-classification paths;
- add a `failover` entry to the overlay catalog in `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-base.md`, keeping the registry/catalog no-drift invariant true;
- author `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-failover.md` with the standard reviewer front matter and the disposition-masking checks;
- add the eval spec `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-failover.eval.yaml`, using the existing `<prompt_id>.eval.yaml` convention;
- wire `code-review-failover` into both round_a and round_b reviewer-dispatch criteria blocks in `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gates/code-review.yaml`, guarded by `${{ steps.*.outputs.include_failover }}` so a routed overlay is actually invoked.

Activation is limited to retry, backoff, fallback, circuit-breaker, timeout, and error-classification paths, including `**/llm/failure.py`, `**/llm/model_classes.py`, `**/llm/tracing.py`, and `should_fall_back` / exception-translation style code wired through the same registry mechanisms existing overlays use.

The reviewer checks whether a fallback or secondary leg's own failure masks or downgrades the primary failure disposition, whether a fallback chain surfaces the most-recoverable leg's disposition, and whether translation/re-raise paths preserve recoverability. Findings must carry the exact criterion tag `failover`, name the before/after surfaced exception type or disposition, and explain how a caller that previously retried could now receive a non-retryable result and give up.

## Out of Scope

- Broad reliability/disposition-accuracy review categories.
- Cause-chain-only or BLE001-carve-out criteria.
- Plan-review criterion work for pure config changes; that sibling gap is tracked by ticket `c789` per the existing comments.
- Changing code-review gate blocking policy beyond registering `failover` as advisory.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] `src/rebar/llm/code_review/registry.py` includes `failover` in `OVERLAY_IDS`, and `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-base.md` documents it in the overlay catalog.
- [x] `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json` registers `failover` with `blocking_enabled: false` and targeted fallback/retry/error-classification activation.
- [x] `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/code-review-failover.md` defines the disposition-masking checks, standard front matter, exact `failover` finding tag, and old-to-new surfaced disposition evidence requirement.
- [x] `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/code-review-failover.eval.yaml` includes a fixture that should flag the incident-shaped retryable-primary masked by fallback failure, plus a benign fallback edit that should not be flagged.
- [x] Registry/routing tests prove the new overlay is discoverable and advisory, and workflow-dispatch tests or structural checks prove `code-review-failover` is present in both round_a and round_b criteria blocks behind `include_failover`.
- [x] Verification: targeted tests for the code-review criteria registry/routing pass, followed before push by `make verify` with the worktree venv on `PATH`.
